events.text: morning. coffee count this week: 14 so far. may need to cut back.
good morning dan. noted. anything else?
priya wants the billing cutover by oct 12. i think it's tight.
saw lena's on-call doc update. pagerduty key is 9A7B2C. for next rotation.
ade got biscuit a new leash. bright orange. very visible.
tom's frontend pr for stripe webhooks broke my test. so annoying.
first interview for new data engineer candidate: maria torres. solid sql.
maria out. she took another offer.
weekend run: prospect park loop. 9.2 miles. felt good.
cutover date moved. priya says nov 5 now. gives breathing room.
new candidate: jordan liu. data eng at spotify before. good take-home.
jordan feedback mixed. lenak thought weak on schema design. moving on.
sam ortiz starts sep 14. finally a data engineer.
migration incident on tuesday. dropped a column instead of renaming. rolled back.
the dropped column was `billing_status`. 3h of panic.
ade's birthday dinner. went to bamonte's. old school italian.
flaky test in ci: test_billing_webhook. fails 20% of the time. so annoying.
cutover slipped again. nov 15 now. priya frustrated but ok.
candidate three: david chen. contractor at doordash. knows dbt.
david chen accepted. sam ortiz onboarding starts with him.
forgot to mention: biscuit ate a sock yesterday. emergency vet trip.
sam starts day after labor day. office is ready.
pagerduty key changed per lena: new key is 3F8D1A.
run update: hit 10.1 miles. new personal best.
tuesday just after sam's start we had that incident. sep 15 if i recall.
billing cutover final date: oct 12 again. we got back on track.
flaky test fix attempt failed. still 20%.
saw david chen at the office. he sat next to tom.
morning. pagerduty key is now 7C2E9B. lena's final decision.
ade's planning a trip to asheville for us. october.
candidates interviewed: 3. maria, jordan, david. david joined.
on-call rotation next week. i'm primary, tom secondary.
stripe webhooks moved to own service. tom did it in a weekend.
the dropped column incident was august 18. never forget.
run in williamsburg. 8.7 miles. slower than usual.
sam asked about the old on-call key. told him 9A7B2C was revoked.
biscuit learned 'roll over'. ade taught him with treats.
teammate count: 4 eng. me, tom, lena, sam. priya manages.
asheville trip booked: oct 22-25. cabin near blue ridge.
flaky test resolved. test_billing_webhook now 0% failure. finally.
tom's frontend refactor broke webhooks again. second time.
webhooks fix by tom took 2 days. back to normal.
priya confirmed: billing cutover still oct 12. no more changes.
team now 5. david chen joined officially.
sam's first solo deploy today. nailed it.
ade's making jollof rice tonight. my favorite.
last night's on-call: pagerduty key 7C2E9B worked fine.
vet visit for biscuit: weighs 42 lbs. healthy boy.
ade wants to foster another dog. i'm not ready.
sam showed me his dbt models. clean code.
